demo.title: callput.sh
demo.code:
# Read-only discovery
bankr prompt "Using the Callput skill, list live assets and scan the best bullish TSLA spread. Do not prepare or submit a transaction."

# Review risk, then explicitly approve preparation
bankr prompt "Using the Callput skill, scan the top bullish BTC spread for 1 contract. Show maximum USDC at risk, fees, expiry, strikes, wallet, and network, then ask for my explicit approval before preparing any transaction."

# Manage an existing position
bankr prompt "Using the Callput skill, review my Callput positions and identify anything expiring within 24 hours. Do not close or settle without my explicit minimum-output approval."

setup: Add the remote MCP server https://mcp.callput.app/api/mcp using HTTP transport and no authentication
Run a read-only asset list and spread scan before preparing a transaction
Use a Base wallet funded with USDC plus a small amount of ETH for gas; every approval and order requires Bankr confirmation
